- Game Hub: a new shelf look is the default. Covers stand on wooden shelves; a tap opens the box (turn it, open the lid, see the manual, take the disc out); the setup has five steps and opens on first use; the details page is upright with Overview and Settings tabs. Other looks are unchanged.
- Game Hub: performance is the default game mode; tiles start small; the cover of the Continue playing card can be removed.
- Network type: the modem's own preferred mode is tried first, per SIM, before the older settings.
- Files: a failed compression shows its reason; zip compression no longer fails with "Prefix string too short".
- Files: long-press on a Recent file selects it in its folder.
- Picker: Screenshots and Frequent folders in the side panel; music picks open the folder with the most songs; songs with lyrics are dimmed at the bottom.
- Lyrics: AI button beside share on the cover; an editor for line times and text (follows the playing line, play and pause inside); a background batch for songs without lyrics; a library page in the lyrics extra app.
- Pulse AI: long songs are listened to in 4-minute chunks; songs without lyrics are listed with search on the speech page; model downloads use Pulse's downloader.
- Keyboard: a stray shift no longer capitalises ordinary words for good; password-manager suggestions stay behind the bar.
- Icons: the icon chooser puts its choices on their own row and suggests glyphs that fit the name first.
- Toolkit: Tilt-shift tile removed; short rows are centred.
